name: Italian Ground Turkey White Bean Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 1 (14.5 oz.) can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
why: Verified from source page: 422 cal / 21g carbs / 41g protein per serving, squarely mid-band. One-pan ground turkey skillet (no rice/pasta/potato), high protein-to-calorie from lean turkey + parmesan. Scales cleanly to 14 servings with weigh-and-divide. Distinct from existing turkey white-bean entries (those are stews/cassoulet/chili, not an Italian skillet). Cannellini beans are a genuinely absent board ingredient - good pricer-lane test.
